task.text: Build a html artifact suite. The core layout, styles and js can all be in a shell template. Then page templates with all prerequisite styles and scripting so they can be edited into the shell.

files.b: The most recent, active example of styling and layout.
The best representation of a review or shell document. key pieces: theme selector, cards with colour sidebar, floating copy & text buttons.

items: User can navigate directly to all files or sites in question, to check original content.
User can see clearly where the work originates from (branch, issue, pr)
User can always return to the agent with a prompt that progresses the context or conversation
Agent can build artifacts repeatedly with consistent features and styling. focusing on content.
Agent is token efficient. strategically building or editing a document.
Artifacts preserve users history (decision and response) when updating. but doesn't enter return prompt unless edited.

items.b: shell for every page template. Has all the base styling, layout and scripting. copy prompt
agent presents findings or results. user can approve and comment on each change
agent asks user a series of questions, to gain further insight.
active demonstrate a portion or component.
provide the user options to choose from. recommended, extra comments
core issue, investigation results, additional comments.
collapsed link to file or location in question when available.
quote section for users comments from the chat, that apply to card contents.
show only relevant cards per filter. (eg integrate, your call, defer)
colour red gray green (remove, keep, add). The + or - marker colored & in a consistent margin next to content. not in content box.
each page builds a return prompt for the agent, with advanced context guiding next steps.
